'''City Plaza''', also known as '''Central Plaza''', was a plaza in [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].

==History==
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] captured City Plaza to use as a landing zone during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. During a lull in the battle, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] shuttle landed in City Plaza, where it was met by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
